motivation: MZ-D7 (#221 sec 15 revival): the standing T0 result 'random still leads' is re-tested where QD has theoretical room - evaluation cost dominates search cost.  Tier T2 = one long deterministic lifetime per genome (LIFETIME_ECOLOGY_V2, 12 epochs, escalating difficulty, two revocation waves, RESET control), measured 0.481 ms/genome ~ 5.7x T0.  Archive D (developmental descriptors) is the new diversity axis; the T0 descriptor degeneracy (8/4/18 occupied cells) is broken at T2 (50/83/64).  Retention value is real and one-sided at T2 (9504 positive / 19080 zero / 0 negative of 28584 feasible).

census_truth_P00C.structural_finding: consolidation_ratio is IDENTICALLY 0 over the frozen V1 census space (its only charging paths - T_family in {recurrent_event_graph, distributed_local_controllers, growing_pruning} and L == consolidation_schema_residual - are absent from the 56160-genome space); the D_dev_3d third axis is therefore primitive_pressure_slope, not consolidation_ratio (P00C v2, 2026-09-09)

tier_rules_amend3.env: ZOO_TIER=T2 for every arm including P01 (both sides of every comparison evaluated at T2)
tier_rules_amend3.scalar: dev_score shape unchanged, re-referenced to the T2 census medians (W2_REF=484.7, B2_REF=152.8) so the cost term is ~1 at the feasible median; T0 formula and W_REF/B_REF stay frozen for all T0 scoring
tier_rules_amend3.reset_control: run_lifetime2(reset=True) inside every T2 evaluation; retention per genome = solved_fraction_continued - solved_fraction_reset (>=0 for every feasible census genome)
tier_rules_amend3.ecology_frozen: LIFETIME_ECOLOGY_V2 as in evaluation/lifetime2.py at this commit (epochs 12, difficulty_growth 0.15, acquisitions_per_epoch 3, revocation_epochs [6,10], schedule as coded); the T0 battery lifetime.py is untouched

arms.note: structural-grid control that does not see Archive D: does structural QD transfer to the developmental objective?

metrics_amend3: pareto_recovery_T2 = |archive phenotypes ∩ census P00C T2 pareto (792)| / 792
CVTD_niche_recovery = |nearest census-CVT-D niches of archive phenotypes| / 64
S3d_cell_recovery = |archive S_structural_3d@10 cells ∩ T0 census occupied (8)| / 8
best_dev_T2, qd_score_T2 (T2 scalar over the arm's own archive cells), n_elites
retention_positive_elite_fraction = elites with continued-minus-reset solved_fraction > 1e-9 / n_elites
frontier_retention_fraction = retention-positive fraction among the arm's top-32 elites by dev_score_T2

scoring_rules_amend3.matched_pair_rule_FROZEN: each QD arm is paired against P01_random_search_T2 on [pareto_recovery_T2, own_axis_recovery, best_dev_T2], seed-means: strictly >= on all three and > on at least one => QD wins the pair; the inverse => P01 wins; otherwise TIE (identical in form to amend-2's frozen rule)
scoring_rules_amend3.retention_frontier_rule_FROZEN: an arm is retention-frontier-positive if frontier_retention_fraction >= 0.5 on every seed
terminal_rule_FROZEN: DEVELOPMENTAL_MORPHOLOGY_ADVANTAGE_SUPPORTED_AT_SCOPE: >= 3 of the 4 QD arms win their P01 pair AND every winning arm is retention-frontier-positive
DIVERSE_HIGH_PERFORMING_MORPHOLOGIES_FOUND_AT_SCOPE: some D-archive arm (P05/P06/P09) has own_axis_recovery >= 0.25 on seed-means AND its best_dev_T2 (seed-mean) >= P01 best_dev_T2 (seed-mean) - 0.01
QD_NO_ADVANTAGE_OVER_MULTI_OBJECTIVE_PARENT: P01 wins >= 1 pair and no QD arm wins any (the stronger negative: random still leads where evaluation is expensive)
scoring_rules_amend3.aggregation: aggregate runs only when all 15 tasks have ok dispositions and verifiable receipts; verdicts are computed mechanically from these rules, never narrated
